question.prompt: What is the difference between the sum of the first \(2003\) even counting numbers and the sum of the first \(2003\) odd counting numbers?

solutions.explanation:
The two lists are \(2,4,\ldots,4006\) and \(1,3,\ldots,4005\). Pairing terms in the same position makes the subtraction simple: each even number is exactly \(1\) larger than its partner. Thus the difference of the sums is
\[
(2-1)+(4-3)+\cdots+(4006-4005).
\]
There are \(2003\) pairs, so this equals \(2003\cdot1=2003\), choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
solutions.title: Pair corresponding terms
